equipment_type: VAV compact controller (actuator with flow sensor)
applies_to: Belimo VAV-Compact volumetric flow controllers with the BACnet/Modbus interface (..MV-D3-MOD and ..HV24A-MOD).
summary: The VAV-Compact is a damper actuator with a built-in differential pressure sensor and VAV controller for box-level airflow control. Over BACnet MS/TP it takes a relative setpoint on AO 1 that is scaled between the Min and Max limits and interpreted as airflow or position. It reports damper position, airflow, an optional sensor input and actuator status.
notes: The same devices can also run Modbus RTU; this list covers the BACnet MS/TP mode.
The default setpoint source is Bus.
AI 20 and BI 20 are out of service unless MV 220 selects the matching sensor type and the setpoint source is Bus.
Actuator status faults are latched; clear them with MV 120 Command = Reset.
Flow unit of AI 19 and AV 104 follows MV 121.

integration.summary: Leave MV 122 SpSource on Bus (default), select flow control in MV 123, set Min and Max airflow once, then command AO 1 SpRel. Read AI 19 airflow, AI 1 position and BI 101 summary status. If you turn on the bus watchdog, keep rewriting AO 1 or MO 1 inside the timeout.

minimum_points.name: SpRel
minimum_points.why: Airflow setpoint between Min and Max

integration.enable: MV 122 SpSource = 2 (Bus, the default) makes the actuator follow AO 1. In hybrid mode (SpSource = Analog) the 0-10 V signal on wire 3 is the setpoint and only MO 1 is taken from the bus.
integration.heartbeat: AV 130 Bus Watchdog, 0-3600 s, default 0 (off). When set, each write to AO 1 or MO 1 restarts the timer; on timeout the AO 1 priority array is cleared, the relinquish default (0%) applies and MI 110 shows Bus Watchdog triggered. In hybrid mode only MO 1 writes are tracked.
integration.remote_sensors: Sensor 1 can be read over BACnet when MV 220 is set to Active (AI 20, mV) or Switch (BI 20). Switch mode needs the control signal configured to 2-10 V; restart the actuator after changing the sensor type.
setup: MS/TP: baud 9600-76800, default 38400; MAC address 0-127, default 1; max 32 nodes without repeater.
Quick addressing with the Address and Adaption buttons on the actuator (see datasheet).
Configuration tool: ZTH EU; bus termination state shows in BI 99.
gotchas: Writable objects with instance 90 and above are persistent; do not write them on a regular basis.
Max must be at least Min and above 20%.
Fast open / Fast close overrides add mechanical wear; keep them for time-critical events such as frost protection.
